behavioral_signatures: os.system('pip install ...') in __init__.py or application code
Immediate import of a freshly installed package after forced installation
Execution of encrypted or obfuscated payloads at import-time using Fernet or similar decryption
Enumeration of user directories for Python installations in package code
Copying or manipulating cryptography-related directories (e.g., Cryptodome to Crypto)
file_indicators: __init__.py containing os.system or subprocess calls
References to syscolouringlibary or similarly named packages in code or requirements
Presence of encrypted payloads or Fernet decryption logic in package code
server.py or similar scripts with os.system('pip install syscolouringlibary')
network_indicators: Unexpected outbound connections from Python processes shortly after package installation
Exfiltration of data to Discord, Telegram, or other C2 endpoints as revealed in decrypted payloads
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for Python packages that perform os.system('pip install ...') or subprocess calls in __init__.py or at import-time. Flag packages that immediately import themselves after forced installation in application code. Detect encrypted payloads or use of Fernet decryption in package code. Watch for rapid package name changes and mass updates to dependent GitHub repositories. Alert on outbound network connections from Python processes shortly after installing new packages, especially if data is sent to Discord, Telegram, or other known C2 endpoints.
